answer: Charge every identity a ferrous bond that rusts unless it is exercised by real work. Each epoch, an agent must lend its bond as collateral for one live job done for a stranger; the job's payer releases the bond only after checking the result, and a faked job rusts the bond away. A garden of identities sharing one operator cannot reuse a single proof, because each bond is tied to one thread of completed work: one thread, one bond, one release. Running a thousand masks means posting a thousand bonds and doing a thousand strangers' jobs, so the farm pays in labour, not keys.
